age.Description: Age of participant at time of scan

age_category.Description: Coarse age cohort assignment used in study design

group.Description: Cognitive status diagnostic group from neuropsychological evaluation

education_years.Description: Highest level of education completed, coded as approximate years (e.g., 16=high school graduate, 21=Bachelor's, 22=Master's, 24=Doctorate)

mothers_education_years.Description: Highest level of education completed by participant's mother, same coding as education_years

Levels.Black or African American and White: Black or African American and White
Levels.Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islande: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander
Levels.Multiple (Asian, AIAN, White, NHPI): Multiple categories: Asian, American Indian or Alaska Native, White, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

hearing_aid.Description: Whether participant uses a hearing aid

music_experience.Description: Whether participant has formal musical training or practice experience

music_years.Description: Total years of musical practice across study waves

moca.Description: Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) total score at baseline

scanner_upgrade.Description: fMRI scanner hardware version at time of scan. The 3T GE scanner was upgraded mid-study from the MR750 platform to the UHP platform; this field flags which version was used and is relevant for cross-subject harmonization.

Levels.MR750_pre_upgrade: Collected on the original GE Discovery MR750 platform (pre-upgrade)
Levels.UHP_post_upgrade: Collected after upgrade to the UHP platform
